bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
root=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
p="$root/.worktrees/qwen35-gate-candidate-20261128"
cd "$p"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 327904c559b9a91a24ee436da134811243a4d435
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
candidate=ai-core-model-gate:deepseek-candidate-327904c5
old=ai-core-model-gate:local
backup=ai-core-model-gate:qwen35-candidate-f314b8d5
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")"
oldid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$backup")"
curid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' ai-core-model-gate)"
health() {
 docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import urllib.request; [urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:%d/health"%n,timeout=3).close() for n in (18181,18182,18183,18184,18185,18186)]'
}
check_remote() {
 docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import json,os,urllib.request,urllib.error; headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]}; base="http://127.0.0.1:18186"; r=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+"/v1/models",headers=headers),timeout=6));assert r["data"]==[{"object":"model","id":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017"}]
try:
 urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+"/v1/chat/completions",headers=headers,data=b"{}"),timeout=5)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
 assert e.code==403 and json.load(e)["error"]["code"]=="REMOTE_DATA_CLASS_NOT_ADMITTED"
else:
 raise AssertionError("REMOTE_DATA_CLASS_NOT_ENFORCED")
print("REMOTE_GATE_IDENTITY_AND_DATA_CLASS=PASS")'
}
if [ "$curid" = "$newid" ]; then health;check_remote;echo DEEPSEEK_GATE_ALREADY_ACTIVE;exit;fi
test "$curid" = "$oldid"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$old")" = "$oldid"
test -z "$(ss -H -lnt 'sport = :18186')"
for n in ai-coder ai-qwen3 ai-granite ai-ministral ai-qwen35; do test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = false; done
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import json,os,urllib.request; h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]}; get=lambda p:json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184"+p,headers=h),timeout=8)); a=get("/internal/handoff/status"); b=get("/internal/resources/status"); assert not a["resident"] and not any(a["active"].values()) and not a["handoff"] and not a["recovery_pending"] and b["queued"]==0; print("IDLE_EXISTING_GATE_CONFIRMED")'
test -f /home/admin1/.config/libral-vault/ai-core-token
test "$(stat -c '%a' /home/admin1/.config/libral-vault/ai-core-token)" = 600
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' libral-vault-libral-vault-1)" = healthy
export AI_CORE_API_KEY="$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sh -c 'printf "%s" "$AI_CORE_API_KEY"')"
test "${#AI_CORE_API_KEY}" -ge 16
docker compose -p ai-core-gate -f "$p/compose.gate.yml" -f "$p/compose.gate.openrouter.yml" --project-directory "$root" --env-file "$root/.env" config -q
rollback() {
 rc=$?;trap - ERR;set +e
 echo "DEEPSEEK_GATE_ACTIVATION_FAILED_EXIT=$rc"
 docker logs --tail 60 ai-core-model-gate 2>&1 | grep -E 'MODEL_GATE=FAIL|MODEL_GATE_PARENT_BUDGET|MODEL_GATE_MODE' | tail -10
 docker image tag "$backup" "$old"
 docker compose -p ai-core-gate -f "$p/compose.gate.yml" --project-directory "$root" --env-file "$root/.env" up -d --no-build --force-recreate gate
 for k in $(seq 1 15); do
  if docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import urllib.request; [urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:%d/health"%n,timeout=3).close() for n in (18181,18182,18183,18184,18185)]' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo RESTORED_QWEN35_GATE_HEALTH=PASS;break;fi
  sleep 2
 done
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
docker image tag "$candidate" "$old"
docker compose -p ai-core-gate -f "$p/compose.gate.yml" -f "$p/compose.gate.openrouter.yml" --project-directory "$root" --env-file "$root/.env" up -d --no-build --force-recreate gate
ready=NO
for k in $(seq 1 15); do
 if health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=YES;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = YES
for f in compose.runtime.yml runtime/model-policy.yaml runtime/model_gate.py runtime/remote_model_gate.py; do
 test "$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d ' ' -f1)" = "$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sha256sum "/app/$f" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
done
check_remote
trap - ERR
echo SHARED_GATE_DEEPSEEK_AND_QWEN35_ACTIVATION=PASS_HEALTH_6_OF_6
